h: Torah Rebuilds the Walls and Refines the Heart

p: "And I will make your pinnacles of kadkod,
In the Pesikta on this haftarah it is stated
Eliyahu gave to the lad in the sea,
to show Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi.
And likewise "and your gates of carbuncles"
it is stated in the Gemara (Bava Basra 75a)
that a certain student saw in the sea
and sawing precious stones and pearls
that were thirty by thirty, etc.,
to set them up in the gates of Yerushalayim.
That is, most precious stones and pearls
for this is the main protection;
but one who occupies himself with Torah";
"and Torah scholars do not need protection."
And this is alluded to by the fact that
the stones of the walls are found in the sea;
"For the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Hashem
as the waters cover the sea";
and as they said at the beginning of Sefer HaBahir:
And this is why all the consolation was
and it is as it says (Shemos 32:16):
that is, the words of Torah
are engraved upon the heart of stone.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה א, ב)
And as they said (Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2):
בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁשָּׁמְעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ
the evil inclination was uprooted from their heart";
and this was in the first Commandments.
But afterward, with the second Tablets,
"Carve for yourself two tablets of stone";
carve, hew and engrave the heart of stone,
"and I will write upon the tablets"
יַשְׁפִּיעַ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בָּהֶם הַדִּבְרֵי תּוֹרָה
Hashem Yisbarach will bestow the words of Torah upon them.
And this is what it said (Yeshayahu 54:12):
"and all your borders of precious stones";
that is, the stones, the heart of stone,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קלח, א)
שֶׁלֶּעָתִיד יוּשְׁאַר הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שֶׁל תַּאֲוָה
that in the future the evil inclination of desire will remain,
only it will be whitened of its wickedness,
so that the longing will be only for words of Torah;
"For were it not for the evil inclination,
there would be no joy in learning."
And this is the meaning of
"and all your borders of precious stones."
עַל מַה שֶּׁאָמַר עֲנִיָּה מִדִּבְרֵי תּוֹרָה
for what it said, "afflicted" of words of Torah.

p: "And all your children shall be taught of Hashem," etc.;
וְאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קסט, ב)
and it is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 169b):
"'And all your children shall be taught of Hashem'
אוֹלִיף לוֹן קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא אוֹרַיְיתָא
"does the Holy One, blessed be He, teach them Torah?
and gives them strength and might
for were it not for the help of the Holy One, blessed be He,
those children could not bear it."
"In the fourth quarter what does He do?
but from the holy Zohar it appears
דְּקָאֵי עַל תִּינוֹקֹת שֶׁל בֵּית רַבָּן בְּחַיִּים
that it refers to living schoolchildren,
by giving them strength to bear it.
And it brings from the pasuk
אֶת מִי יוֹרֶה וְגוֹמֵר גְּמוּלֵי מֵחָלָב
"Whom shall He teach," etc., "those weaned from the milk,"
that as soon as he is weaned from his milk
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר וְכָל בָּנַיִךְ לִמּוּדֵי ה׳
And this is what it said, "And all your children shall be taught of Hashem":
that words of Torah are found among you,
And the holy Zohar says further there
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ גַּם בַּגְּמָרָא (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יב, ב)
as they also said in the Gemara (Bava Basra 12b);
'And all your children shall be taught of Hashem'
they are certainly taught of Hashem,
and prophecy goes forth from them."
is the name of the attributes Netzach and Hod,
of which Moshe Rabbeinu and Aharon
they are called "the taught of Hashem":
Moshe, the groomsman of the King,
and Aharon, the groomsman of the Queen,
as is known that they taught
and brought the words of Torah into the heart of Yisrael.
the aspect of "the two true prophets";
the holy Zohar cited above said:
And it said, "and great shall be the peace of your children":
meaning that there are found among Yisrael
"Do not read 'banayich,' your children, but 'bonayich,' your builders."
And well known is the explanation of the Shelah
that wherever they said "do not read,"
the meaning is that one cannot read it so
unless one also reads it thus.
are called in the aspect of children of the Omnipresent;
for in prayer one is like a servant before the king,
are called in the aspect of a son.
וְזֶה אַל תִּקְרָא בָּנָיִךְ אֶלָּא בּוֹנָיִךְ
And this is "do not read 'your children' but 'your builders'":
who are occupied with the building of the world," etc.;
that they build the walls of Yerushalayim,
"'I am a wall' — this is Torah;
אֵלּוּ תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא ז, ב)
and then you can read "your children,"
for they are like children to the Omnipresent.
And this is what it said in the consolation:
"all your children shall be taught of Hashem"
"and great shall be the peace of your children"
that there are also Torah scholars in Yisrael,
who are always the builders of the wall.
for what it said, "afflicted" of words of Torah.

p: "Ho, everyone who thirsts, come to the water";
"'Hoi' is a term of calling," etc.;
that it is not a cry of woe but a calling:
"everyone who thirsts, come to the water";
which is expounded in the Gemara (Taanis 7a)
as referring to a student who is not worthy,
for of the worthy it is written (Yeshayahu 21:14):
"Whoever teaches a student who is not worthy
"is like one who throws a stone," etc.
nevertheless, to the student himself it said
that although he is not yet worthy,
that it is better that he not learn,
as is stated in the holy books
that he can add further strength
What have you to do with declaring My statutes?"
שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ רַק חֵשֶׁק לְדִבְרֵי תּוֹרָה
one who has only a longing for words of Torah,
even though his heart is not yet refined,
And on this it is written (Mishlei 25:21–22):
that is, the evil inclination wants
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה מְפַתֶּה לָאָדָם לִפְעָמִים
and through this it sometimes entices a person
as is stated in the holy books
כִּי גֶחָלִים אַתָּה חוֹתֶה עַל רֹאשׁוֹ
"for you heap coals of fire upon his head";
it will not carry out its scheme,
for the light within it will bring him back to the good
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה אֵיכָה פְּתִיחָה ב)
(as they said in Midrash Rabbah, Eichah, Pesichta 2).
And this is what it said, "and Hashem will reward you";
"He will make him at peace with you."
the attribute of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁאֵין לוֹ הַחֵשֶׁק לְדִבְרֵי תּוֹרָה
that is, one who has no longing for words of Torah
כִּי גֶחָלִים אַתָּה חוֹתֶה עַל רֹאשׁוֹ
"for you heap coals of fire upon his head."
וּמִמַּה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר אַחַר כָּךְ (יְשַׁעְיָה נה, ב)
And from what it says afterward (Yeshayahu 55:2):
"Why do you spend money for that which is not bread,
and your labor for that which does not satisfy?"
is the toil in words of Torah;
and it is as they said (Tanchuma, Noach 3)
And here the Torah is likened
That is, there is one who does not yet feel
any taste in the study of Torah,
and for him the Torah is called
which one drinks only for thirst,
in the manner of what they said (Berachos 44a):
"One who drinks water for his thirst recites," etc.
And it is also likened to wine and milk,
that is, when one feels taste in words of Torah;
and these beverages are fit for drinking
even when one is not thirsty.
And this is what it said:
"Ho, everyone who thirsts, come to the water":
that although he is not worthy,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם כָּל שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ רַק חֵשֶׁק
nevertheless, whoever has only a longing
וְהוּא כְּעֵין שֶׁאָמְרוּ (עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה יט, א)
It is like what they said (Avodah Zarah 19a):
וְאַף עַל גַּב דְּלָא יָדַע מַאי קָאָמַר
"even though he does not know what he is saying";
for he does not yet feel any taste.
feed him of the bread of Torah.
even if he cannot merit the toil
that is, that they compel themselves
וְאֵין טוֹב אֶלָּא תּוֹרָה (בְּרָכוֹת ה, א)
"and let your soul delight itself in fatness."
And on Shabbos all of Yisrael
are in the aspect of Torah scholars,
from what they said in the Gemara (Shabbos 119a):
"Are you more important to us than it?";
and as they said (beginning of Seder Eliyahu Rabbah):
for on Shabbos every one of Yisrael
is free for words of Torah.
And this is why we say this consolation:
Yisrael is not afflicted of the Torah.
